[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Esmin Darr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She served under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Seeral Korrd|Korrd]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Darr's first name is revealed in a in-game mail message from Darr, congratulating the player for their assistance on Manaan. This mail is only received, when siding with Darth Norok against Colonel Korrd.<ref name="FWD: Service commendation">{{TORcite|type=message|FWD: Service commendation|Lieutenant Darr}}</ref>
